store.summary: Nomad MCP: an MCP server you can take anywhere, for Claude, ChatGPT and Codex
store.description: By Tech Nomad Ted, TheTechNomad.com. Nomad MCP turns the CardputerZero into an MCP server you can take anywhere. AI apps (Claude, ChatGPT developer mode, OpenAI Codex and other MCP clients) can use it from wherever the device has internet: run commands and long background jobs, read, write and edit files, install and run programs (with an Admin / sudo switch), take screenshots of the built-in screen, and run TNT AV Net Tools checks when that app is installed. It connects out through a free ngrok tunnel, so no ports are opened on the network. QR codes on the screen walk you through making the free ngrok account and pasting the token from your phone, then show the connector address as a QR code. A no-account quick test tunnel and Cloudflare are also available. Each app signs in with OAuth plus a one-time pairing code shown on this screen. Turn it on or off, watch live activity, disconnect everyone and set permissions from the keyboard.
